title: Systems check runner
description: Runs the host checks that touch Docker, disk or git (the console doctor's report, disk use, Docker space, the checkout's git state) on a timer and runs their Auto fixes from a fixed list, so a dead console is still seen and fixed. Checks that only read console state stay in the container.

sudo.why: the host report (console-doctor.sh --report): mosh, tmux, Docker, the update cron, Claude, git auth, volumes
Docker space use for the disk check
Auto fix host-docker / host-update-cron: re-run the console installer

actions.title: Auto fix
actions.description: Run one host check's fix from the whitelist.

replaces.name: Jobs._run
replaces.where: apps/console-web/plugins/systems-check/server/hostfix.py (Auto fix through Mosses and vps.run for the fixes listed in HOST_FIXES)
